signal: Filevine raised $400M across two rounds, hit a $3B valuation in 2025, and acquired Pincites in December 2025 to push its AI-first legal operating system.

email.body1:
Whitney, saw Filevine raised $400M, hit a $3B valuation, and acquired Pincites to push the AI-first legal OS.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market firms than the team can cover before momentum cools, and that is where deals slip, often with the sales engineering bottleneck right behind it. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Whitney, quick follow-up for Filevine.

With $400M raised, the pipeline target usually climbs faster than headcount, and that floods the technical sales motion with poorly qualified meetings. Most teams don't know exactly how many qualified meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings Filevine needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Whitney, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other AI legal-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Whitney, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling qualified pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Post-raise growth is its own kind of busy, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your technical sales motion? I'll tailor it to Filevine either way.
